parameters.description:
Send an email notification through your own Mailgun account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-mailgun_email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). On the Apprise channels the gateway composes an Apprise `mailgun://` URL from your stored secrets and delivers via apprise.unitysvc.dev; on the gateway channels it transforms the envelope directly into a Mailgun Messages API form body and posts it to api.mailgun.net with no Apprise involved.

Four channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (`user_secret`, `host_secret`, `apikey_secret`); the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to your Mailgun sending domain (no Apprise); and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment Mailgun destinations, direct, at $0.001 per message.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Mailgun destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Mailgun sending domain (no Apprise)

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Mailgun apikey

user_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Mailgun user
